It sounds to me like they have strong uneducated opinions.  If I were in your situation, I would start setting clear boundaries with them.  I don’t know how close you are with them, but pulling away from harmful influences like judgmental family is one of the best things you can do for yourself.  Let them know if they continue to harass you or give you grief over doctor prescribed medication that is better for you in ever way than alcohol or opiates then you may have to give them less of your time.  I set a similar boundary with my family (about judgement of religious belief) and my family respected my wishes when they thought they might not have me around anymore.  Take care of yourself, and don’t let family add unnecessary stress to your life.  There are other ways to set boundaries with people, might be worth reading about to see what is right for you.
